
===== SRC n=1 hash=0000000000000001 shader=1 len=0 =====
#version 300 es
#extension GL_NV_shader_noperspective_interpolation : require

precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
uniform highp vec4 sk_RTAdjust;
uniform highp mat3 umatrix_S1_c0;
in highp vec4 corner_and_radius_outsets;
in highp vec4 aa_bloat_and_coverage;
in highp vec4 radii_selector;
in highp vec4 skew;
in highp vec2 translate;
in highp vec4 radii_x;
in highp vec4 radii_y;
in mediump vec4 color;
in highp vec4 local_rect;
flat out mediump vec4 vcolor_S0;
noperspective out highp vec2 varccoord_S0;
out highp vec2 vTransformedCoords_2_S0;
void main() {
	// Primitive Processor FillRRectOp::Processor
	vcolor_S0 = color;
	highp float aa_bloat_multiplier = 1.0;
	highp vec2 corner = corner_and_radius_outsets.xy;
	highp vec2 radius_outset = corner_and_radius_outsets.zw;
	highp vec2 aa_bloat_direction = aa_bloat_and_coverage.xy;
	highp float is_linear_coverage = aa_bloat_and_coverage.w;
	highp vec2 pixellength = inversesqrt(vec2(dot(skew.xz, skew.xz), dot(skew.yw, skew.yw)));
	highp vec4 normalized_axis_dirs = skew * pixellength.xyxy;
	highp vec2 axiswidths = (abs(normalized_axis_dirs.xy) + abs(normalized_axis_dirs.zw));
	highp vec2 aa_bloatradius = axiswidths * pixellength * .5;
	highp vec4 radii_and_neighbors = radii_selector * mat4(radii_x, radii_y, radii_x.yxwz, radii_y.wzyx);
	highp vec2 radii = radii_and_neighbors.xy;
	highp vec2 neighbor_radii = radii_and_neighbors.zw;
	highp float coverage_multiplier = 1.0;
	if (any(lessThan(radii, aa_bloatradius * 1.5))) {
		radii = vec2(0.0);
		aa_bloat_direction = sign(corner);
		is_linear_coverage = 1.0;
	} else {
		radii = clamp(radii, pixellength * 1.5, 2.0 - pixellength * 1.5);
		neighbor_radii = clamp(neighbor_radii, pixellength * 1.5, 2.0 - pixellength * 1.5);
		highp vec2 spacing = 2.0 - radii - neighbor_radii;
		highp vec2 extra_pad = max(pixellength * .0625 - spacing, vec2(0.0));
		radii -= extra_pad * .5;
	}
	highp vec2 aa_outset = aa_bloat_direction * aa_bloatradius * aa_bloat_multiplier;
	highp vec2 vertexpos = corner + radius_outset * radii + aa_outset;
	if (is_linear_coverage != 0.0) {
		varccoord_S0 = vec2(0.0, coverage_multiplier);
	} else {
		highp vec2 arccoord = 1.0 - abs(radius_outset) + aa_outset / radii * corner;
		varccoord_S0 = vec2(arccoord.x + 1.0, arccoord.y);
	}
	highp mat2 skewmatrix = mat2(skew.xy, skew.zw);
	highp vec2 devcoord = vertexpos * skewmatrix + translate;
	highp vec2 localcoord = (local_rect.xy * (1.0 - vertexpos) + local_rect.zw * (1.0 + vertexpos)) * .5;
	gl_Position = vec4(devcoord, 0.0, 1.0);
	vTransformedCoords_2_S0 = mat3x2(umatrix_S1_c0) * vec3(localcoord, 1.0);
	gl_Position = vec4(gl_Position.xy * sk_RTAdjust.xz + gl_Position.ww * sk_RTAdjust.yw, 0.0, gl_Position.w);
}

===== SRC n=2 hash=0000000000000002 shader=2 len=0 =====
#version 300 es
#extension GL_NV_shader_noperspective_interpolation : require

precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
out mediump vec4 sk_FragColor;
uniform sampler2D uTextureSampler_0_S1;
flat in mediump vec4 vcolor_S0;
noperspective in highp vec2 varccoord_S0;
in highp vec2 vTransformedCoords_2_S0;
void main() {
	// Stage 0, FillRRectOp::Processor
	mediump vec4 outputColor_S0;
	outputColor_S0 = vcolor_S0;
	highp float x_plus_1 = varccoord_S0.x, y = varccoord_S0.y;
	mediump float coverage;
	if (0.0 == x_plus_1) {
		coverage = float(y);
	} else {
		highp float fn = x_plus_1 * (x_plus_1 - 2.0);
		fn = y * y + fn;
		highp float fnwidth = fwidth(fn);
		coverage = .5 - float(fn / fnwidth);
		coverage = clamp(coverage, 0.0, 1.0);
	}
	mediump vec4 outputCoverage_S0 = vec4(coverage);
	mediump vec4 output_S1;
	output_S1 = texture(uTextureSampler_0_S1, vTransformedCoords_2_S0, -0.475) * outputColor_S0;
	{ // Xfer Processor: Porter Duff
		sk_FragColor = output_S1 * outputCoverage_S0;
	}
}

===== SRC n=3 hash=0000000000000003 shader=3 len=0 =====
#version 300 es
#extension GL_NV_shader_noperspective_interpolation : require
#extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external_essl3 : require

precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
out mediump vec4 sk_FragColor;
uniform mediump samplerExternalOES uTextureSampler_0_S1;
flat in mediump vec4 vcolor_S0;
noperspective in highp vec2 varccoord_S0;
in highp vec2 vTransformedCoords_2_S0;
void main() {
	mediump vec4 outputColor_S0;
	outputColor_S0 = vcolor_S0;
	highp float x_plus_1 = varccoord_S0.x, y = varccoord_S0.y;
	mediump float coverage = clamp(y, 0.0, 1.0);
	mediump vec4 outputCoverage_S0 = vec4(coverage);
	mediump vec4 output_S1;
	output_S1 = texture(uTextureSampler_0_S1, vTransformedCoords_2_S0) * outputColor_S0;
	{
		sk_FragColor = output_S1 * outputCoverage_S0;
	}
}

===== SRC n=4 hash=0000000000000004 shader=4 len=0 =====
#version 300 es

precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
uniform highp vec2 u_skRTFlip;
out mediump vec4 sk_FragColor;
uniform highp vec4 uinnerRect_S2;
uniform mediump vec2 uradiusPlusHalf_S2;
uniform sampler2D uTextureSampler_0_S1;
in highp vec2 vTransformedCoords_2_S0;
highp vec4 sk_FragCoord;
void main() {
	sk_FragCoord = vec4(gl_FragCoord.x, u_skRTFlip.x + u_skRTFlip.y * gl_FragCoord.y, gl_FragCoord.z, gl_FragCoord.w);
	mediump vec4 outputColor_S0 = vec4(1.0);
	mediump vec4 outputCoverage_S0 = vec4(1.0);
	mediump vec4 output_S1 = texture(uTextureSampler_0_S1, vTransformedCoords_2_S0, -0.475);
	mediump vec4 output_S2;
	highp vec2 dxy0 = uinnerRect_S2.xy - sk_FragCoord.xy;
	highp vec2 dxy1 = sk_FragCoord.xy - uinnerRect_S2.zw;
	highp vec2 dxy = max(max(dxy0, dxy1), 0.0);
	mediump float alpha = clamp(uradiusPlusHalf_S2.x - length(dxy), 0.0, 1.0);
	output_S2 = outputCoverage_S0 * alpha;
	{
		sk_FragColor = output_S1 * output_S2;
	}
}

===== SRC n=5 hash=0000000000000005 shader=5 len=0 =====
#version 300 es

precision mediump float;
precision mediump sampler2D;
out mediump vec4 sk_FragColor;
uniform highp vec4 uinnerRect_S2;
uniform mediump vec2 uradiusPlusHalf_S2;
uniform sampler2D uTextureSampler_0_S1;
in highp vec2 vTransformedCoords_2_S0;
highp vec4 sk_FragCoord;
void main() {
	sk_FragCoord = vec4(gl_FragCoord.x, gl_FragCoord.y, gl_FragCoord.z, gl_FragCoord.w);
	mediump vec4 output_S1 = texture(uTextureSampler_0_S1, vTransformedCoords_2_S0);
	highp vec2 dxy = max(max(uinnerRect_S2.xy - sk_FragCoord.xy, sk_FragCoord.xy - uinnerRect_S2.zw), 0.0);
	mediump vec4 output_S2 = vec4(clamp(uradiusPlusHalf_S2.x - length(dxy), 0.0, 1.0));
	{
		sk_FragColor = output_S1 * output_S2;
	}
}

precision mediump float;
out mediump vec4 sk_FragColor;
uniform highp vec4 uinnerRect_S2;
uniform mediump vec2 uradiusPlusHalf_S2;
uniform mediump samplerExternalOES uTextureSampler_0_S1;
in highp vec2 vTransformedCoords_2_S0;
highp vec4 sk_FragCoord;
void main() {
	sk_FragCoord = vec4(gl_FragCoord.x, gl_FragCoord.y, gl_FragCoord.z, gl_FragCoord.w);
	mediump vec4 output_S1 = texture(uTextureSampler_0_S1, vTransformedCoords_2_S0);
	highp vec2 dxy = max(max(uinnerRect_S2.xy - sk_FragCoord.xy, sk_FragCoord.xy - uinnerRect_S2.zw), 0.0);
	mediump vec4 output_S2 = vec4(clamp(uradiusPlusHalf_S2.x - length(dxy), 0.0, 1.0));
	{
		sk_FragColor = output_S1 * output_S2;
	}
}
